# NFIL3D

> NFIL3D (nfil3d.com) is an Indian 3D printing brand that sells 1.75 mm 3D printer filament, FDM and resin 3D printers, 3D pens, 3D scanners and accessories. It is backed by 37+ years of experience in engineering plastic compounds and biopolymers, a 4 lakh sq. ft. facility and an in-house filament testing lab.

Key facts:
- Filament: 1.75 mm PLA+ (solid, matte, clear, metallic, fluorescent, glow-in-the-dark, Turbo-Finish, lightweight), carbon fibre PLA+, rPLA, PETG, HI ABS+, ABS FR, ASA, HIPS and nylon
- Printers: NFIL3D Mini-N, N1 and N2 (FDM); Halot ONE, SKY and MAX (resin)
- Warranty: lifetime on filament against manufacturing defects; 1 year on NFIL3D printers
- Shipping: free on all orders within India
- Support: +91-80 80 80 1204, sales@nfil3d.com, WhatsApp; Monday to Saturday, 9:00 am to 5:30 pm
